title: Release logical hosting accounts with observed bundle pin
problem: Protected preflight run 40102469434 matched every source module, version, JWT and status but rejected the raw downloaded bundle digest. No release writes occurred.
expected_behavior: Release unchanged product source 1dee65da7b68f12d147d11e3f02befae06416ef2 with refreshed manifest SHA256 8f4995fe40f523f06a372fa5de08a8ff802960108f4e7435245e2f618f2c51b2. Target sandy-customer-provisioning-api existing v12, preserve verify_jwt=true and all unchanged deployed modules. Apply only migrations 20261024010000 and 20261024010010; keep operation exposure disabled. Expected candidate v13 and function rollback v14. No gateway/provider/runtime deployment, paid infrastructure, DNS, traffic, IAM, credential or delegation changes. Preserve all customer/account/audit data on rollback. Protected executor must independently verify this genuine Owner audit, exact live preimage, source CI, component lease and recovery artifact before dispatch.
change_purpose: Pin exact Management API bundle SHA256 271ce5ac663f6ca6a688e7c901220b2ac3fe6704689d0d74c845cb71b3a7d99e observed in run 40102469434. All before/after module digests, v12 baseline, source and migrations are unchanged. Supersedes 6b60ac54-9308-414c-bf39-f0b7ca6abc25 for execution without reusing its approval.
feature_improvement: Enable non-billable tenant-bound logical account create/get with existing customer identity, idempotency and audit; no provider provisioning.
acceptance_criteria: Verify exact v12 source/module and bundle digests, immutable candidate source and manifest
Apply additive account schema and inactive contracts through the bounded protected executor
Verify deployed candidate modules/JWT and capture real release receipts without claiming customer acceptance
Coordinate gateway availability and real verified sandy.chat owner-session canary separately
regression_rules: Supersedes 6b60ac54-9308-414c-bf39-f0b7ca6abc25 for dispatch; require genuine new exact-pin Owner approval
Preserve existing data and unchanged source bytes; rollback function only with exact candidate preimage
Do not deploy shared gateway/provider/runtime services or change their registrations
No new paid resources, credentials, IAM, DNS, traffic or persistent grants
No automatic replay of uncertain writes; reconcile before further action
